title: A Framework for Human Evaluation of Large Language Models in Healthcare Derived from Literature Review

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation using Likert scales (e.g., 1-5 rating of balanced/unbiased presentation) and binary categorization to assess the presence of systematic racial prejudices in LLM-generated healthcare responses and medical management plans.
